entities.summary: Zoology is a academic major in the field of biology that originated in Europe during the Classical era. It emerged as a distinct discipline within the framework of ancient Greek and Roman knowledge systems, drawing upon the work of philosophers such as Aristotle and Theophrastus. As the study of animal life and diversity expanded, zoology became a vital component of the scientific revolution of the 16th and 17th centuries, influencing fields such as medicine, natural history, and conservation. Today, zoology continues to play a crucial role in our understanding of the natural world, informing conservation efforts, advancing biomedical research, and shaping our relationship with the environment.
